newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat's Magneti Marelli sees 1996 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Fiat's Magneti Marelli sees 1996 profit up.

text.p: Italian auto components firm Magneti Marelli, part of the Fiat group said it expects to post 1996 consolidated pretax profit of 92 billion lire, up from 75.5 billion in 1995.
Magnet said in a statement based on provisional figures the improvement was largely due to lower financial charges.
Group operating profit was seen slightly lower at about 150 billion lire against a previous 159 billion but with net revenue seen rising 3.8 percent to 5.8 trillion lire.
Group financial debt at end-1996 was around 217 billion lire against 217 billion in 1995.
Research and Development investments remained at a high level last year at around 720 billion lire, or some 12 percent of turnover.
